comments.author: OracMort
comments.body:
Quest Text (missing above)

Remember that merchant in Nagasaki? The one who is a compatriot of yours? Well we have a request from him. He says he saw something dimly lit in the darkness. He thinks it might be a will-o'-the-wisp. This sounds like it might be a dangerous request! I hope you'll be alright!

comments.author: OracMort
comments.body:
Nagasaki : Dubious Merchant :-

Please listen to me! It's a curse! And all the city official can say is "Don't be frightened!"
And they still can't tell us what the shining light is! It's cruel!

comments.author: OracMort
comments.body:
Nagasaki: City Official :-

Some people have to much imagination. Well I guess he just doesn't know. It's not the fires of hell or some will-o-the-wisp.
It's just a glowing mushroom.
The mushroom is not bad to look at, but you mustn't eat it.
It's poison.

comments.author: OracMort
comments.body:
Quest Window text :

Apparently, that faint glow comes from a mushroom. But they have forbidden it's consumption since it is poisonous. I believe I will go to the outskirts of town and look at it myself.
